name: Reggaeton sub tresillo
desc: Modern perreo sub-bass: a round FM sine root gated into the 3+3+2 tresillo (hits on the 1, 4 and 7), the last held on a long release as an anticipation into the downbeat, walking an i-VI-iv-V root progression in G minor that turns each cycle. Dark and clubby with off-eighth octave pops; peak busier.

code.sparse: note("<g1 c2 eb1 d2>").struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${fm}).fmh(2).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.2).slow(16)).attack(.01).decay(.4).sustain(.55).release(.24).shape(.3).gain(${gain}*.9).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
code.full: note("<g1 c2 eb1 d2>").struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${fm}).fmh(2).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).attack(.008).decay(.4).sustain(.55).release(.24).shape(.5).gain(${gain}).room(.1).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(${gain}*.5)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<g1 c2 eb1 d2>").struct("x ~ x x ~ x x ~").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${fm}).fmh(2).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.9, ${cut}*1.8).slow(8)).attack(.006).decay(.35).sustain(.5).release(.2).shape(.55).gain(${gain}).room(.1).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note("<7 12>")).gain(${gain}*.5)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
